name: BRXKEN INSIDE
source:
Shion's calm and measured life comes to an end when she meets Akiko. This encounter has the chance to change her life or plunge it further into the abyss of depression and hopelessness.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186690/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
当紫苑遇见明子时，她平静而按部就班的生活迎来了终结。这场邂逅既有可能改变她的人生，也有可能将她推入更深的抑郁与绝望深渊。

[引自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2186690/]Steam[/url]]
